description:
Activate Grinding Station by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
